# oauth2_relay — OAuth2 client_credentials + GraphQL Relay pagination
# Verifies: the runner fetches an OAuth2 token, then POSTs the GraphQL query
# to /oauth2_relay/graphql with variables.after driven by relay_cursor.
# PageSize=2, EventsPerDrain=5 → 3 pages (2 + 2 + 1) of relay-style cursor
# pagination; pageInfo.hasNextPage drives termination on page 3.
# The token endpoint is handled by the auth layer (not traced as an exchange).

replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999/oauth2/token $URL/oauth2_relay/token
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
replace spec.yml /api/v1/graphql /oauth2_relay/graphql
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    initial_interval:
      type: duration
      default: "720h"
    page_size:
      type: int
      default: 2
    token_url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999/oauth2/token"
    client_id:
      type: string
      default: "test-client"
    client_secret:
      type: secret
      default: "test-secret"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  oauth2:
    client_credentials:
      token_url: {ref: state.token_url}
      client_id: {ref: state.client_id}
      client_secret: {ref: state.client_secret}
      cache:
        store_in: token
        expiry_field: expires_in
        expiry_buffer: 60s

requests:
  - method: POST
    path: /api/v1/graphql
    body:
      json:
        query: |
          query Issues($after: String, $first: Int) {
            issues(after: $after, first: $first) {
              nodes { id created_at }
              pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
            }
          }
        variables:
          object:
            after: {from_pagination: relay_cursor}
            first: {ref: state.page_size}

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: data.issues.nodes

pagination:
  graphql_relay:
    has_next_page_at: data.issues.pageInfo.hasNextPage
    end_cursor_at: data.issues.pageInfo.endCursor
    cursor_var: after

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: created_at

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_trace.jsonl --
